title: Clone Only When Shared
goal: Mutate an `Rc` buffer efficiently using clone-on-write with `Rc::make_mut`.
hints: Cloning data every time you mutate wastes memory allocations when the handle is already unique.
`Rc::make_mut` checks reference counts. It only clones data when active sharing is present.
explanation: `Rc::make_mut` implements copy-on-write. When the `Rc` is uniquely owned, it borrows the inner vector mutably without cloning. Unconditionally dereferencing and cloning allocates a fresh vector on every call. That creates a new `Rc` pointer and fails the pointer identity check.
